briefing: NASDAQ +0.8% and S&P 500 +0.6% is a mild risk-on day, not the strong (2%+) signal our strategy memory requires to deploy fresh capital. With only $189.29 cash on hand, well below the $500 threshold, we're holding all 7 existing positions and sitting out new buys rather than forcing a marginal trade.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept in reserve so you can act when a truly compelling opportunity appears. Today's market only offered a mild risk-on signal, and our remaining cash was below the threshold needed to add a new position responsibly, so we preserved it rather than forcing a trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指的是保留現金以便在真正具吸引力的機會出現時能夠出手。今日市場僅呈現溫和的風險偏好訊號,而剩餘現金也低於安全加碼的門檻,因此我們選擇保留資金,而非勉強進場。

market_education.summary_en: Markets edged higher today with the S&P 500 and NASDAQ both posting modest gains, reflecting a generally constructive but unremarkable trading session. No standout catalyst drove the move — it looks like broad, low-conviction buying rather than a reaction to a single major headline. Momentum names like NVDA continued to show healthy technical setups without extreme overbought readings.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤溫和走高,標普500指數與納斯達克指數同步小幅上漲,反映市場氣氛整體正面但缺乏明顯驚喜。今日走勢並無單一重大消息帶動,較像是資金廣泛但保守地流入,而非對特定利多消息的反應。以NVDA為首的動能股維持健康的技術面格局,未見過熱訊號。
